title: Body Parts in English and French

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Let's learn our body, in English, and in French!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bobo nods his head. Nod, nod, nod!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Leo blinks his eyes. Blink, blink!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bobo wiggles his round ears. Wiggle, wiggle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Quiz time! Where are the eyes?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Leo smells a flower with his nose. Sniff, sniff! Mmm!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bobo opens his mouth, and eats a big apple. Crunch!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Leo claps his hands. Clap, clap, clap!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Quiz time! Where is the nose?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: There! In the middle of the face!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bobo stretches his arms up high. Stretch!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Bobo's tummy says rumble, rumble! Ha ha!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Quiz time! Where are the hands?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: There! At the end of the arms!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bobo hops on his legs. Hop, hop, hop!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Leo stomps his feet. Stomp, stomp!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now, let's say them all in French!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's play Simon says! Touch your head!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How do you say hands, in French?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
